Mark it, glitter it, circle it in pink 💗 Fae Tality Rexia is turning up the birthday energy and taking over the Ranchero Room with a full cast of Tri-Cities sparkle by her side. Ember Rexia co-hosts, the wigs are teased sky-high, and the fairy tale drama is very much encouraged. This isn't just another Saturday — it's Fae's night, and Azucar is throwing the whole party for her. Expect pastels, glitter, big hair, bigger personalities, and a lineup ready to turn the stage into a birthday spectacle. Doors open early because you do NOT want to walk in during the first number. Dress whimsical, arrive shining, and come ready to celebrate somebody who deserves every bit of the spotlight 🎂✨

Saturday, August 8th • Doors 8PM, Show 9PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
🎟️ $10
🔞 21+

Picture it: pink smoke, glitter drifting under the lights, and a wig collection that could start its own weather system 🌸✨ The Ranchero Room turns into a fairy tale fever dream as Fae Tality Rexia's birthday bash takes the stage, with Ember Rexia right there co-hosting the madness. Feel the bass thump in your chest, the shimmer of sequins catching every light, the crowd's energy building number after number. Pastels clash with drama, whimsical meets glam, and every corner of the room feels like it's part of the show. This is the kind of night where you lose track of time because you're too busy soaking in the color and the chaos. Come dressed like you belong in the fairy tale 🧚‍♀️💫

Bring the sparkle you've been saving for a special occasion — this is it 💖 Fae Tality Rexia's birthday bash is an open invitation to the whole community to show up as loud, soft, glittery, or whimsical as you feel. Ember Rexia co-hosts a night built on celebration, connection, and a cast of Tri-Cities performers who make this room feel like home. No dress code except more sparkle, no pressure except to have a good time. This is Pasco's Latinx community and beyond, gathering to celebrate one of our own with the kind of love that only a full house can give. Come as you are, dance next to someone new, and leave feeling like you found your people 🌟🎉

Here's everything you need to know before Saturday 📋💕 Fae Tality Rexia's birthday bash hits Azucar's Ranchero Room with Ember Rexia co-hosting and a full cast of Tri-Cities performers ready to celebrate. Doors open at 8PM, the show kicks off at 9PM, and it's $10 at the door — cash or card, just get there early because seats fill fast. Dress whimsical, think pastels and glitter and a little fairy tale flair, and get ready for a night that's all about the birthday queen. 21+ only, ID required.
